lines.item: For Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd., Dongguan

statements.text_en: This supply agreement is between Soony Interactive GmbH, Leopoldstraße 180, 80804 Munich, Germany and Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd., Dongguan.
statements.quote: between Soony Interactive GmbH, Leopoldstraße 180, 80804 Munich, Germany and Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd., Dongguan

statements.text_en: Supplier manufactures and supplies the parts listed in Annex A for Soony's products.
statements.quote: Supplier manufactures and supplies the parts listed in Annex A for Soony's products.

statements.text_en: Supplier reserves capacity for Soony's rolling 12-month forecast ±20 %.
statements.quote: Supplier reserves capacity for Soony's rolling 12-month forecast ±20 %.

statements.text_en: Lead times per Annex A, counted from PO acknowledgement. Supplier acknowledges POs within 3 working days.
statements.quote: Lead times per Annex A, counted from PO acknowledgement. Supplier acknowledges POs within 3 working days.

statements.text_en: Supplier's plant closes for Chinese New Year for up to 12 calendar days. Supplier communicates the shutdown schedule by 30 November and adjusts confirmed dates accordingly.
statements.quote: Supplier's plant closes for Chinese New Year for up to 12 calendar days. Supplier communicates the shutdown schedule by 30 November and adjusts confirmed dates accordingly.

statements.text_en: Deliveries are made FOB Yantian (Incoterms 2010) unless the purchase order states otherwise.
statements.quote: Deliveries are made FOB Yantian (Incoterms 2010) unless the purchase order states otherwise.

statements.text_en: Prices per Annex A, in CNY. Payment terms NET30 from receipt of a correct invoice.
statements.quote: Prices per Annex A, in CNY. Payment terms NET30 from receipt of a correct invoice.

statements.text_en: PPAP level 3 for new part numbers. Changes to process, site or sub-supplier require Soony's written approval (PCN, 90 days).
statements.quote: PPAP level 3 for new part numbers. Changes to process, site or sub-supplier require Soony's written approval (PCN, 90 days).

statements.text_en: Late delivery: 0.5 % of the delayed order value per commenced week, capped at 5 %.
statements.quote: Late delivery: 0.5 % of the delayed order value per commenced week, capped at 5 %.

statements.text_en: Neither party is liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, war, epidemics and governmental acts. The affected party notifies the other party within 48 hours and uses reasonable efforts to mitigate.
statements.quote: Neither party is liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, war, epidemics and governmental acts. The affected party notifies the other party within 48 hours and uses reasonable efforts to mitigate.

statements.text_en: Supplier confirms that no sub-supplier provides a critical material for Soony parts.
statements.quote: Supplier confirms that no sub-supplier provides a critical material for Soony parts.

statements.text_en: Each party keeps the other party's information confidential for 5 years after termination.
statements.quote: Each party keeps the other party's information confidential for 5 years after termination.

statements.text_en: Supplier maintains product liability insurance of at least EUR 5 million per event.
statements.quote: Supplier maintains product liability insurance of at least EUR 5 million per event.

statements.text_en: This Agreement runs from 2018-03-01 until 2027-02-28. Either party may terminate for convenience with six months' notice.
statements.quote: This Agreement runs from 2018-03-01 until 2027-02-28. Either party may terminate for convenience with six months' notice.

statements.text_en: German law applies. Place of jurisdiction is Munich.
statements.quote: German law applies. Place of jurisdiction is Munich.

verdict.summary_en: The contract is mostly clear and fully signed/stamped, but one Annex A item description appears truncated, so the document is only partially readable. No corrections or strike-throughs are visible.
red_flags: Annex A line for CMP-GAM-010 appears incomplete after: "Statue "The Getaway" (die-cast, 18".
Initials fields on pages 1 and 2 appear blank.
Delivery term stated as FOB Yantian (Incoterms 2010) unless the purchase order states otherwise.
Payment terms stated as NET30 from receipt of a correct invoice.
PPAP level 3 is required for new part numbers; process, site or sub-supplier changes require Soony's written approval (PCN, 90 days).
Late delivery penalty stated as 0.5 % per commenced week, capped at 5 %.
Supplier reserves capacity for Soony's rolling 12-month forecast ±20 %.
Chinese New Year shutdown may last up to 12 calendar days, with schedule communicated by 30 November.
Supplier must maintain product liability insurance of at least EUR 5 million per event.
Agreement term stated as 2018-03-01 to 2027-02-28; termination for convenience requires six months' notice.
observations: The provided PDF text layer is blank on earlier pages; the readable contract content is visible in scanned page images.
Grey stamped mark on page 1 reads: "RECEIVED 2018-03".
Blue handwritten signatures are present for both parties on page 3.
A red round company seal is present on page 3, including the Chinese text "合同专用章".
The Annex A description for CMP-GAM-010 appears cut off after "(die-cast, 18".
